blocking_issues: [LIVE RUNTIME BUG — Deployed Agent Runtime Cold Start Orphans Engines & Mismatches Lab 2 Sandbox Template Parent] When Lab 3 Terraform deploys `google_vertex_ai_reasoning_engine.coding_agent` (`{starter,solution}/terraform/main.tf:217-230`), it injects `SANDBOX_MODE` (`byoc`/`shell`), `SANDBOX_TEMPLATE_NAME` (created under Lab 2's parent `ReasoningEngine` A), and `SANDBOX_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL`, while Agent Runtime auto-injects `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT`, `GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION`, and `GOOGLE_CLOUD_AGENT_ENGINE_ID` (runtime B) — NOT `REASONING_ENGINE_NAME`.
